decision.reason: The only upstream evidence, [ev-1b184dd5af6a], is a one-line highlight that names a feature, "optional Kustomize components", and the Kustomization kind. It doesn't say which field, key or API version adds this, how optional components behave, or whether existing behaviour changes. The install.yaml excerpts [ev-782bc47d120d] and [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] show only "apiVersion: v1". The validator also refuted P4's claim that the GVK itself was added. To write the subject, change and applicability, we need the controller changelog, the API docs or the CRD schema diff that names the new field.
